en: Multiview color postcard showing the exterior terrace and interior dining rooms of mid‑century restaurants. The main view features the modernist building with a sign reading RESTAURANT DANUBIU and a busy outdoor terrace with umbrellas; the smaller images show set tables and decor inside. The back is a Romanian divided back labeled CARTE POȘTALĂ with a printed price and caption listing restaurants in Tulcea County.
